Head of Growth Partnerships, Slingshot AI

Slingshot AI is building the foundation model for psychology. We are looking
for a Head of Growth Partnerships to own our partner channel and accelerate
consumer adoption of Ash, our AI for mental health.

What you will do
- Own and grow a portfolio of distribution partnerships end to end
- Build repeatable partner playbooks alongside product and marketing
- Negotiate commercial terms and manage ongoing partner performance
- Report on channel performance to the leadership team

What we are looking for
- 4-6 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or growth
  roles at a consumer technology company
- A record of closing and scaling distribution deals
- Comfort operating in a fast moving startup environment
- Based in New York or open to relocating

Why this fixture exists: this posting reached Krish and was approved before
anyone read the years requirement. A posting titled Head of X demanding 4 to
6 years is not a fit for a sixteen year operator. Gate G4 exists because of
this exact miss, and this file must FAIL G4 forever.
